errors.text: The proposed Y2O3 addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated processing and oxidation-protection strategy, particularly hydride-based printing/sintering, oxygen control, quench stabilization, and the silicide coating.
None of the cited studies provides evidence that adding 1–2 wt% Y2O3 improves oxidation resistance in equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr.
The mechanism incorrectly assumes that dispersed Y2O3 will form a continuous protective surface layer; a processing or transport mechanism capable of producing such a layer is not specified.
Preservation of room- and high-temperature mechanical performance is asserted but not supported, despite the possibility that oxide addition could cause inclusions, embrittlement, or phase changes.
